config.record_grain: One row per current Australian Financial Services licence register entry

fields.evidence: Help File p.8 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee ABN or ACN; sample row 2 header/value AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN=85007186003 is an 11-digit identifier. The abn operation validates ABN checksum and emits no value for a valid ACN.

Help File p.8 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee ABN or ACN; the supplied column is explicitly polymorphic. The acn operation validates ACN checksum and emits no value for a valid ABN; no ABN suffix inference is used.
Help File p.9 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL is the locality of the current principal business address; sample row 2 has SOUTHBANK.
Help File p.10 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE is the state from the current principal business address; sample rows 2–3 show VIC and NSW.

Help File p.10 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE is the postcode from the current principal business address; sample row 2 has 3006. The postcode operation preserves source string semantics and does not infer padding for damaged values.
Help File p.10 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY is the country of the principal business address and countries outside Australia are set to International; sample rows 2–3 have Australia.

unmapped_fields.reason: Identifies the register entry, not a canonical ontology field; it is not evidence of legal entity type or name.
Licence identifier has no corresponding field in the supplied ontology; preserved as unmapped rather than invented as an entity identifier.
This is the date the AFS licence was issued, not company/entity registration; the ontology has no licence start-date field and it must not map to entity.date_registered (Help File p.8).
Historical superseded licence identifiers and types are nested text with no ontology target; they are not current entity identifiers (Help File p.9).
Current licence authorisations/conditions are nested text with no ontology target (Help File p.11); they do not establish entity industry, status, or legal name.

limitations: The source is a snapshot of current Australian Financial Services licensees, but a current licence is not evidence that the legal entity is active, nor does it prove deregistration if a licence later changes or is revoked.

AFS_LIC_NAME is retained as the raw subject label only; the documentation calls it the register entry name and it may represent a person or organisation, so it is not mapped to legal_name or trading_name.
AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is a mixed ABN/ACN column; each value is independently checksum-validated and only the matching ontology identifier is emitted.
The source exposes principal business address components but no full street address, so address.full is not mapped.
The source documentation describes current records but supplies no row-level status or explicit legal-entity type; entity.status and entity.entity_type remain unmapped.

observed_at uses the supplied publication timestamp 2026-09-16T21:52:45.982310 as a publication proxy, not a row-change timestamp; ingested_at and other observation-envelope fields are supplied by the ingestion system.
All authority and field confidence scores are provisional and require human review.
